evidence: Cic. Off. 3.3.13: quod propriē vērēque dīcitur (Lewis & Short s.v. proprius)

terms.gloss: word for word, literally (of a translation or of learning by heart)
evidence: Cic. Fin. 1.2.4: fābellae Latīnae ad verbum dē Graecīs expressae (Lewis & Short s.v. verbum)
terms.comment: Also verbum ē verbō and verbum prō verbō; Lewis & Short notes that Cicero uses verbum ē verbō where one word renders one word.

sources: Lewis & Short: proprie · Lewis & Short: uerbum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 340.
